settings.question: Do you deliver everywhere in Lebanon?
settings.answer: Yes. Delivery takes 2 to 4 days and costs $5, free on orders from $35.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: In cash when your order arrives, in US dollars. You don't need an account to order.

settings.question: How fast do you send my order?
settings.answer: Pieces in stock leave the same day. We confirm your order by WhatsApp or phone first.

settings.question: Is the planter good for real plants?
settings.answer: Yes. It has a drainage hole and its own drip tray, so you can water it as usual. Empty the tray after watering.

settings.question: Can the bud vase hold water?
settings.answer: It is made for dried or faux stems, because a printed vase isn't reliably watertight.

settings.question: Are the coasters fine with hot drinks?
settings.answer: They are printed in PETG, which is tougher than everyday PLA and fine for cups and glasses. Keep them away from hot pans and the dishwasher.

settings.question: What is 3D printing, and is it safe at home?
settings.answer: Our printer builds each piece from thin layers of plastic, 0.2 mm at a time. The pieces are safe to use around the home. Keep them out of hot cars, where the plastic can soften.

settings.question: Can I get another colour or my own design?
settings.answer: Not on the site yet. Message us on WhatsApp and we will tell you what we can make.

settings.heading: Still have a question?
settings.text: Ask us on WhatsApp. We usually reply within the hour.
